selection_rule: Prioritize sources only by expected marginal gain in independent event coverage, PIT coverage, temporal depth, informational breadth, provenance/reproducibility and feasible acquisition cost. Linked-asset realized returns and ARGOS PnL are forbidden inputs.

source_classes.prediction_market_primary: Can add independent events and/or pre-event prediction-market state.
source_classes.prediction_market_robustness: Useful for external validity but not pooled into the primary real-money universe without a separate freeze.
source_classes.archive_secondary: Large historical archive used to repair/enrich/verify official venue data; never silently overrides official semantics.
source_classes.linked_asset_market_data: Potential future outcome/response layer; access may be researched now but realized outcomes remain unopened until W4-H.

sources.access: public Gamma + Data API + public CLOB market-data endpoints
sources.historical_depth: price history plus public trade/activity surfaces; on-chain reconstruction available
sources.granularity: event/market/token, trades, price history, current order book
sources.next_gate: series-first exhaustive recensus + canonical event clustering + PIT coverage table
sources.evidence_note: Official APIs support discovery, public trade/activity data and CLOB market-data/history. Existing W2 material must be reused without reading linked-asset returns.

sources.access: public series/markets plus live and historical market-data endpoints

sources.next_gate: complete series-first capacity census; then prove trade/candlestick T-10d to cutoff coverage
sources.evidence_note: Historical market filters are mutually exclusive. W4-A v1.1 queries series_ticker alone and excludes MVE locally; one-route failures are recorded fail-closed.

sources.access: public downloadable daily and intraday CSV files
sources.historical_depth: dated files exposed through the public data archive
sources.granularity: pairs, closing prices, product/trading summary; intraday pairs refreshed during the day
sources.next_gate: enumerate all historical files, classify against frozen families, prove timestamp semantics and unique-event counts
sources.evidence_note: Official site exposes Pairs, Prices and Summary CSVs and identifies ForecastEx as a CFTC-regulated market.

sources.access: public market-data surfaces exist; full historical depth still requires audit

sources.next_gate: separate product-reference files from historical tradable prices and prove archive depth
sources.evidence_note: Do not count listed/reference contracts as backtestable until historical prices and PIT timestamps are reproducibly accessible.

sources.next_gate: find and validate reproducible historical contract-price/trade access before inclusion

sources.access: public regulator registry
sources.historical_depth: N/A

sources.evidence_note: Designation is only a candidate-discovery signal. Every venue must independently pass historical data, PIT, semantics and reproducibility gates.

sources.access: public API and research/bulk data surfaces

sources.next_gate: freeze a separate robustness protocol; never pool directly with real-money primary venues without authorization

sources.access: public Hugging Face dataset, CC-BY-4.0
sources.historical_depth: 2022-11-21 through 2026-04-28 in accompanying paper

sources.evidence_note: Dataset card reports 2,642,204,336 rows / 49.1 GB. Paper describes 1.20B trade records across 1.30M markets. It is derived from public on-chain activity and is not endorsed by Polymarket, so official-source reconciliation is mandatory.

priority_routes.route: Repair Kalshi and finish its series-first census
priority_routes.why: Direct independent-N candidate with official historical trades/candles.
Official public event-contract archive can add genuinely independent macro observations with low acquisition cost.

priority_routes.route: Polymarket exhaustive recensus plus Polymarket-v1 archive reconciliation
priority_routes.why: Combines official semantics with an extremely deep on-chain archive, maximizing both N discovery and microstructure depth.
Raises N_final_backtestable by converting raw candidates into PIT-certifiable canonical events and enables revision-aware features.

priority_routes.route: Audit every current event-oriented CFTC DCM through DATA_ACCESS_GATE
priority_routes.why: Potential new venues should be screened systematically rather than assumed unavailable.
Does not raise independent N but can make each event response much richer and support options/implied-distribution analyses.

required: historical data are actually retrievable, not merely documented or listed
timestamps and timezone semantics are explicit
pre-event history can be separated from post-event data
identifiers can be mapped to canonical_event_id without outcome-dependent choices
raw responses/files can be hashed and reproduced
data_access_gate.failure_policy: Do not count the source toward N_final_backtestable; retain it as a documented candidate or prospective collector.
